cited.quote: held the discussions with the farmers and collected their views
consultative meetings with stakeholders were conducted this year also, as was done in previous years
present the agriculture budget for the second time on the floor of this Assembly

rationale: C2 is the 2021-22 exclusive Agriculture Budget, drafted after discussions with farmers and representatives of Farmers Associations of 18 districts. C1 (2022-23, second budget) and C3 (2025-26, stakeholder consultations again) show it recurs annually. Scope matches the promise.

cited.quote: New Government ITIs have been started in the State in following unserved areas at a cost of Rs.97.55 Crore
Establishing new Government ITIs in less developed areas of the State will enhance the number of skilled workforce

rationale: C4 and C2 report new ITIs, but explicitly in unserved or less developed areas (Valparai, Harur, Thiruchuli and similar), not in industrial cities as promised. No extract shows an official step for ITIs in industrial cities; related activity only.

cited.quote: Handloom Weavers will be eligible to get supply of 300 units of electricity bimonthly free of cost
The Government have enhanced the free electricity supply to Handloom weavers from 200 units to 300 units bimonthly with effect from 03.03.2023

rationale: C2 is G.O.(Ms).No.40 dated 2023-03-03 raising free handloom electricity from 200 to 300 units bimonthly; C3 recites the election manifesto promise as its basis. C1 confirms enhancement effective 03.03.2023 and funds released. Exactly as promised.

None of the extracts concerns Auto Nagars. They cover TNHB housing, a Salem planning area declaration, auto service societies for rickshaw drivers, smart cities and an aerospace policy. Nothing relates to the commitment.

No extract concerns identity cards for artists. The extracts cover disability identity cards, Aadhaar authentication notifications and pensioner health insurance cards, which are different groups and subjects.

cited.quote: restored to the 01.04.2012 level by passing resolution in Valuation Committee and implemented from 01.04.2023
the Government have announced to revise the guideline value to the rates prevailing till 08.06.2017

rationale: Directional commitment. C4 reports the guideline values were restored to the 2012 level by Valuation Committee resolution and implemented from 01.04.2023, with a further minimum value fixed from 16.08.2023. C1 corroborates the 2023-24 revision and the earlier rationalisation committee. A dedicated official revision of guideline values was implemented.

cited.quote: urge the Union Government to advise the Government of Sri Lanka to ensure that Eelam Tamils have equal civil and political rights

rationale: C1 is a Governor's address stating intent to urge the Union on Eelam Tamils' civil rights and citizenship, which is a different request from an international independent judicial body for war crimes. Other extracts are about fishermen, courts and audit. No formal step on this issue is shown.

cited.quote: grant permission for the sale of Minor Millets in select Fair Price Shops / Retail outlets run by Cooperatives
These grains are sold at selected FPS and cooperative retail outlets.

rationale: C2 (and C1) is G.O.(Ms) No.10 of 2022-01-25 permitting sale of minor millets, procured via farmer producer organisations, in select fair price shops on a pilot basis, i.e. a limited quantity. C5 confirms sales through selected FPS from June 2022. Procurement is via FPOs rather than directly, a minor gap.

cited.quote: Green Tamil Nadu Mission Administrative and Financial sanction for implementation during the year 2021-2022
Increasing Forest and Tree cover is important to ecology and economy as a viable nature-based solution

rationale: C3 and C4 are G.O.(Ms) No.126 of 2021-12-09 giving administrative and financial sanction to the Green Tamil Nadu Mission to increase forest and tree cover for climate and environment benefit. C2 describes the mission among state programmes. Matches the state-wide tree planting scheme.

cited.quote: Action is being taken by the Water Committee (headed by Revenue Divisional Resource Department to evict the

rationale: C3 says action is being taken to evict encroachments in water bodies and gives a cumulative eviction total without dates, and its committees come from a 2014 order. C1 and C2 are audit findings on earlier years; C5 only declares tanks free of encroachment. No dated official step within this term is shown.

cited.quote: Groups to the tune of Rs.2674.64 crore which

rationale: Directional commitment. C2 lists an SHG loan waiver 2021 covering Rs.2674.64 crore of cooperative loans for 1,17,617 women SHGs, among the waivers the Government has granted. The exact order date for the SHG waiver is not given, only the year. The Poo Malai scheme is not mentioned in any extract.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu Widows and Destitute Women Welfare Board has been constituted with 14 non-official members and 10 official members

rationale: C5 shows a Board for widows and destitute women (2022) whose mandate includes employment promotion, but no extract shows jobs being provided or a scheme for widowed or abandoned women above 35. C4 (compassionate appointment) and C3 (unemployment assistance) concern other groups. Only related activity.

cited.quote: In this context, from the year 2022-23 desilting of
the district-wise length covered during the year 2022-23 and 2023-24 is given below

rationale: C2 says desilting of C and D channels in the Grand Anicut and Cauvery delta areas incl. Thanjavur was carried out from 2022-23; C1 (GO of 2024-02-26) tabulates Thanjavur lengths desilted in 2022-23 and 2023-24 and sanctions more; C2 sanctions 2025-26 works. The first GO itself is not in the extracts.

cited.quote: the Government constitutes the Farmer-Wildlife Conflict Resolution Committee to suggest measures to ensure sustainable co-existence of farmers and wildlife

rationale: No extract shows an order creating Agricultural Development Councils. C5 constitutes a Farmer-Wildlife Conflict Resolution Committee, a narrower body on wildlife conflict, and C1 reconstitutes a coconut scheme monitoring committee. These are related activity, not the councils promised.

The extracts are notifications on regulating marketing of agricultural produce, a TNAU board nomination and an Aadhaar notification. None concerns Agricultural Development Councils or a notification establishing them.

cited.quote: Plantation of 70 lakh saplings in rural areas to a total cost of Rs.275.00 crore
A spacing of 10 m between the plants is to be adopted for Avenue plantation

rationale: C1 and C3 are MGNREGS orders for avenue plantation along rural roads. The promise concerns trees along the entire route of a particular path for cooling, and no extract identifies that path or any dedicated step for it. Only related, general roadside plantation is shown.

cited.quote: OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF RURAL AGRICULTURE MARKET IN YEDAPALLI VILLAGE OF NILGIRIS DISTRICT FOR FARMERS
the Government hereby direct Tiruppur Market Committee to establish a market at Nathakadaiyur Village

rationale: C3 is a GO of 2021-10-25 sanctioning funds with guidelines for a rural agriculture market in Yedapalli, Nilgiris, run under the Marketing Department. C1 (2025) directs a new regulated market at Nathakadaiyur. Only specific markets are shown, not a broad network of rural markets.

cited.quote: Subsidy assistance of 40% of the unit cost of the engine or Rs.48,000/- whichever is less is being provided
providing 1,000 Outboard Motors (OBM)/Inboard Engines (IBE) for traditional fishing crafts at 40% subsidy

rationale: C2 (2021-22) already shows a 40% engine subsidy, and C3, C4 and C1 show it unchanged at 40% (Rs.48,000 cap). No extract shows an order raising the engine subsidy percentage; C1 only continues 40% for 1,000 engines.

cited.quote: This Department is mandated to monitor the progress of all the Schemes, Programmes and Projects

rationale: C1 to C3 describe the Special Programme Implementation Department and its Chief Minister review programme, but no extract shows an order creating a new separate department; the commitment is also unspecific about which department. C4 and C5 concern a planning fund and school education. No creation step shown.

cited.quote: The Lok Ayukta will be revitalized and empowered to deal with complaints against public authorities including elected representatives

rationale: Directional commitment. C1 is only a statement of intent in the Governor's address (will be revitalized). The other extracts concern Lok Adalats, DISHA and MLA development funds, not the Lok Ayukta. No dedicated GO, law or scheme is shown.
